Fundraiser – Paid Weekly, No Experience Needed

Public Outreach Consultancy Inc runs face-to-face fundraising campaigns for well-known non-profit organizations. Our street fundraisers talk with members of the public about causes they care about and sign up monthly donors.

What you'll do

  • Represent partner charities at high-traffic locations around Arlington
  • Start conversations, explain the cause, and sign up monthly supporters
  • Work with a small team and a team leader who supports your goals

Requirements

  • Must be at least 18 years old
  • Comfortable talking with people outdoors in all weather
  • Available at least three shifts per week

Benefits

  • Guaranteed $20/hr base pay, paid weekly
  • Flexible scheduling that works around classes or creative projects
